errors.empty: The file is empty or couldn't be read.
errors.xlsx: It's an Excel file (.xlsx): save it as CSV or download the Norma 43 file from your bank.
errors.too_many_rows: Too many transactions in one file: download a shorter period.
errors.n43_currency: Only statements in euros can be imported.
errors.csv_no_header: The CSV columns aren't recognized: choose which one is which.
errors.csv_mapping: Columns are missing: the date, the amount (or debit and credit) and the description are required.
errors.csv_no_rows: These columns don't produce any transactions: check the header row and the formats.
errors.too_large: The file is too large (5 MB max).
errors.account_not_found: That account doesn't exist or is closed.
errors.account_mismatch: This statement is for another account.
errors.n43_multiple_accounts: The file contains several accounts: add this account's IBAN in Cash to tell which one it is.
errors.future_movements: The statement has transactions with a future date.
errors.already_imported: This statement has already been imported into this account.
errors.permission: Only a partner can import statements.
errors.generic: The statement couldn't be imported. Please try again.

issues.totalsMismatch: The totals at the end of the account (record 33) don't match the transactions.
issues.balanceMismatch: The file's closing balance doesn't match its opening balance plus the transactions.

issues.missingEnd: The end of file (record 88) is missing: it may be incomplete.
issues.recordCount: The file says it has {declared} records, but it has {found}.
issues.movementsBeforePeriod: There are transactions before the file's period (on {date}): they're included.
issues.movementsAfterPeriod: There are transactions after the file's period (on {date}): they're included.
issues.balanceChain: The running balance breaks in {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} (from row {line}): check the row order or the balance column.

noAccounts.title: First, an account
noAccounts.body: Add the bank accounts in Cash (with their IBAN) to import their statements and reconcile them.

noStatements.title: Import the bank statement
noStatements.body: Once the bank transactions are in, GNERAI OS suggests what each one is (which invoice it collects, which expense it pays) and a partner confirms it in one click.
noStatements.step1: Sign in to your online banking and open this account.
noStatements.step3: Choose the Norma 43 format (also called “Cuaderno 43”, “AEB 43” or “accounting file”). If your bank doesn't offer it, download the transactions as CSV.
noStatements.step4: Choose the period (for example, last month) and upload it here.
noStatements.note: You can upload overlapping statements: transactions that were already there are skipped automatically, even if there are two identical ones on the same day.
noStatements.readOnly: A partner can import the statement.

allDone.title: All reconciled
allDone.body: No transactions left to explain in this account.

filtered.title: Nothing with this filter
filtered.body: Try another month, status or search.

errors.bankAccountInactive: This account is closed: reactivate it in Cash to import statements.
errors.bankStatementInvalid: The statement isn't valid: some transactions can't be told apart.
errors.bankStatementPeriod: Some transactions are outside the statement period or have a future date.
errors.bankStatementDuplicate: This statement has already been imported into this account.
errors.bankStatementInUse: This statement has reconciled or ignored transactions: undo them before deleting it.
errors.bankTransactionIgnored: This transaction is ignored: stop ignoring it before reconciling it.
errors.bankTransactionMatched: This transaction already has something reconciled: undo it before ignoring it.
errors.bankMatchExceedsMovement: The reconciled amount exceeds the transaction amount.
errors.bankMatchExceedsTarget: That's already reconciled with another transaction (or doesn't reach that amount).
errors.bankMatchExceedsOutstanding: The amount exceeds what's left to collect on the invoice.
errors.bankMatchDirection: The direction doesn't match: a credit collects invoices and a debit pays expenses.
errors.bankMatchFixed: A link can't be changed: undo it and reconcile again.
errors.bankInvoiceNotPayable: Only issued invoices from this organization can be collected.
errors.bankRemittanceNotCollectible: This batch hasn't been sent to the bank yet.
errors.remittanceNotSent: Only a batch that's been sent to the bank can be collected.
errors.settleDateInvalid: The credit date can't be in the future.
errors.bankNeedsForm: Review the expense before creating it.
errors.bankSuggestionStale: Something has changed (another statement, another partner…): check the suggestions again.
